title: The Mill Road

victory.note: The Germans win if they end the game in control of 1 hex of the mill (the largest stone building in columns U to EE). Otherwise the Russians win.

situation: The Mill Road runs from west to east through a village. The defenders hold the mill. The attackers have armored vehicles, and the defenders have armor of their own. The Germans attack with 4 squads under 1 leader, 4 support weapons, and 2 armored vehicles. The Russians hold with 3 squads under 1 leader, 3 support weapons, and 1 armored vehicle. The Germans win if they end the game in control of 1 hex of the mill (the largest stone building in columns U to EE). Otherwise the Russians win. The Germans move first. 8 turns.
